checked_routes.result: The official article supports Dogmeat and Preston Garvey (submitted in separate source batches), but does not name Craig Boone, Deathclaw, NCR Veteran Ranger, Noelle Rutherford, Vault Boy, or Vault Girl.
The official profile names Codsworth (submitted separately); it does not identify the other unresolved packet identities.
The official New Vegas product page describes the game and its broad cast but supplies no exact name-to-work roster for the unresolved members, including Craig Boone.

notes: The broad Fallout campaign spans multiple games and contains unresolved packet identities after these distinct official routes. Only exact first-party named identities were proposed; no fan-created identity, faction member, creature variant, or mascot relationship is inferred from missing evidence. This is partial progress only, not a negative or terminal conclusion.
